description: This class `FeatureDefinitionCreatedStrategy` is a Java class that extends an abstract event handling strategy related to 'FeatureDefinitionCreated' events in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It implements an event handler method that updates a ThingBuilder with feature definition data from the event.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractThingEventStrategy to handle FeatureDefinitionCreated events by updating a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: FeatureDefinitionCreatedStrategy
methods.description: Constructor which initializes the strategy. It is protected, suggesting instantiation within package or subclasses.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to process a FeatureDefinitionCreated event by setting the feature definition in the provided ThingBuilder.
